description.value: Kanaka Creek Coffee is a café located at 24155 102 Avenue in the Maple Ridge area of the Fraser Valley, taking its name from nearby Kanaka Creek, a regional park waterway. Beyond its OSM classification as a café, details about its offerings, seating, and cyclist amenities could not be verified due to inaccessible web content.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The only available evidence is the OSM record itself, which contains minimal tags (amenity=cafe, address, name). The website URL points to a Facebook page, but the fetch was blocked by Facebook's rate-limiting ('You're Temporarily Blocked'), yielding no usable content. All amenity and contact fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags, which provide no amenity detail beyond confirming it is a café.
concerns: Facebook URL fetch was blocked by rate-limiting; no website content could be retrieved.
URL discovery confidence is only 'medium' — the Facebook page may not belong to this business.
No phone number available in OSM or from the website.
OSM record contains very minimal tags; address lacks city/postal code.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business appears to be an operating café (OSM looks_closed=false), but the Facebook website was inaccessible and OSM tags contain no amenity detail, making it impossible to confirm cyclist-relevant criteria. A manual check of the Facebook page or an in-person visit is needed before including in the directory.
